component: Board settings: control hidden where it is used (U32)
explanation: The RGB colour field was shown for the Static mode only because Static was the first mode to use it; Immersive fills the room with the same colour and lost its control. A control follows the state that uses its value, not the mode that introduced it. Screenshot: the same panel for context; the 2D build has no Environment tab, so the Immersive state itself is covered by a unit test in CaissaTrainer (boardSettingsPanel.test.ts).
